Stephanie,

Confirmed — IC3 is the correct band for this role/level and the proposed base + equity maps to IC3 median. Details below to populate GH fields:
- Comp band code: IC3
- Base: $185,000 (recruiter to enter as annual salary)
- Bonus target: 7.5% (enter in variable comp section)
- Equity: 0.12% (select "Standard IC3 grant" in stock plan)
- Sign-on: $7,500, payout on first payroll after 30 days (can mark as one-time sign-on)

Approvals: because total cash + equity is within the nominal IC3 threshold, exec approval is not required. People Ops (Neha) needs to do a quick comp sanity check and confirm tax language; after that you can route to Hiring Manager approval and then to Offer Release.

Link: comp-band guidance (internal) — https://drive.redwood/comp/IC3/guide (please attach the PDF to the GH offer)

Monica
Compensation & People Analytics
Redwood Inference

Stephanie — quick confirmation from People Ops: all comp components look good. A few operational notes for GH: 
1) Create the offer in Greenhouse under Erin Walters candidate record.
2) In the "Offer Details" section use the custom fields: "Comp Band = IC3", "Equity Plan = IC3 Standard", "Sign-on Terms = $7,500, one-time".
3) For approvals set the routing: Hiring Manager (Laura) -> Talent Partner (Stephanie) -> People Ops (Neha) -> Offer Release. Since exec approval is not required, do not toggle the Exec Approval flag.
4) Attachments: attach REDWOOD_offer_template_IC3.docx, comp-band-IC3-guidance.pdf, candidate JD. Also attach the calibration notes from the interview loop.
5) DocuSign: generate the DocuSign envelope from GH (we use automatic DocuSign integration). Please set the envelope to require signature from the candidate only — Redwood signs internally at release.

I reviewed the redline on the template for remote-first hires and updated tax language. See attachment comp-band-IC3-guidance.pdf.
